decisions.reason: Because this close-to-core product disappeared from the website by 2024 after only a brief 2023 mention, management would read it as results falling below aspiration and reallocate the resources to stronger core offerings and development projects.

Although it initially had its own page, its complete disappearance in 2024 suggests performance below aspiration relative to the firm's broad established hearing offer, so a behavioral-theory firm would discontinue it.
Its dedicated presence in both 2023 and 2024 indicates it is meeting or at least approaching aspiration within the core business, which supports continuing the product.

Despite being distant from the established offer, it was newly launched in 2024 and given its own page, so with some organizational slack and still-uncertain early results management would likely keep testing it for now.
As a newly launched, close-to-core product that is still mentioned in 2024, it would likely be retained while the firm gathers more evidence before judging it against aspiration levels.
